note: §5 (r4.3): `ts(s)` is the instant the log writes — the node's clock **truncated to the second** — and terms are compared against that and never against the untruncated clock. Here the clock reads 12:00:00.75 and the endorsement's term begins at 12:00:00.5, so an untruncated comparison would say the authority is live. The event will be stamped 12:00:00Z, and every reader of the finished chain compares the term against that, so the gate must too: `out of term`. The vector pins the recorded `ts` as well as the reason, because the rule is precisely that those two agree.

kind.description: A one-field resource, so an authority vector has something harmless to admit.
